{{dablink|For other uses of the word "white," see [[White]].}}
'''The White Boar''' is an inn located in [[Watch Hill]] in the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, White Boar, The}} It sits at the crest of the hill and is visible for some distance around the village. It has a distinctive tile roof, the only inn in Watch Hill to do so.

During their original flight from the Two Rivers, [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Mat Cauthon]] heard the sounds of merry-making from the tavern and wished they could stop for a meal at the White Boar, but the appearance of a [[Draghkar]] changed their minds.

Later, during the [[Whitecloak]] occupation of the Two Rivers, [[Dain Bornhald]] sometimes drunk in the inn, hoping the locals would relax and feed him information. After the Whitecloaks were ejected from the district, the banner of [[Manetheren]] was raised above the inn, as foreseen by [[Perrin Aybara]] in a [[Wolfbrother|wolf dream]].
